# motherduck_snapshot (Resource)

Creates a named MotherDuck database snapshot. Delete removes the snapshot name because MotherDuck has no public snapshot delete command.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "motherduck_database" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}

resource "motherduck_snapshot" "monthly" {
  database = motherduck_database.analytics.name
  name     = "analytics_monthly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database to snapshot.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) Optional operation timeouts. Values use Go duration syntax such as `30s`, `10m`, or `1h`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_ts` (String) Snapshot creation timestamp reported by MotherDuck.
- `id` (String) MotherDuck snapshot ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Optional timeout for creating a MotherDuck database snapshot.
- `delete` (String) Optional timeout for removing the managed snapshot name.
- `read` (String) Optional timeout for refreshing MotherDuck snapshot metadata.
- `update` (String) Optional timeout for renaming a MotherDuck database snapshot.
